description: This file provides utility functions for type assertions and temporary path resolution. It includes functions to safely cast values to specific types, create temporary directory paths with optional customizations, and generate UUIDs. The functions are designed to facilitate handling of unknown data types and temporary file management in the project.

methods.name: export function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> { asRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a Record<string, unknown> if it is an object; otherwise, returns an empty object.

methods.name: export function asString(value: unknown): string | undefined { asString
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a string if it is of type string; otherwise, returns undefined.

methods.name: export function asNumber(value: unknown): number | undefined { asNumber
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a finite number if it is of type number; otherwise, returns undefined.

methods.name: export function asBoolean(value: unknown): boolean | undefined { asBoolean
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a boolean if it is of type boolean; otherwise, returns undefined.

methods.name: export function resolveTempPathParts(opts: { ext: string; tmpDir?: string; id?: string }): { resolveTempPathParts
methods.description: Generates and returns a temporary path configuration object, ensuring the temporary directory exists (creating it if necessary), and assigns a UUID if no id is provided. It also ensures the extension string starts with a dot.

ctags.name: resolveTempPathParts
ctags.pattern: /^export function resolveTempPathParts(opts: { ext: string; tmpDir?: string; id?: string }): {$/
